Print and plot benefit-risk scores

Source: R/plot.BenefitRisk.R, R/print.BenefitRisk.R
BenefitRisk-methods.Rd

print() shows the definition, weight and cutoff of each component and the scores of the cohorts. plot() draws, for each cohort, the posterior probabilities of the components and the composite score as bars, with the admissibility cutoffs as dashed lines.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'BenefitRisk'
plot(
  x,
  col = NULL,
  main = NULL,
  legend.position = c("bottom", "top", "topright", "topleft", "bottomright",
    "bottomleft", "right", "left", "none"),
  cex.main = 1.2,
  cex.lab = 1,
  cex.axis = 1,
  cex.legend = 0.9,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'BenefitRisk'
print(x, digits = 3, ...)

Arguments

x

Data frame returned by BenefitRisk.

col

Colors of the bars: one per component and one for the score (recycled).

main

Title of the plot.

legend.position

Position of the legend: "bottom" (below the plot, the default) or "top" (above the plot) for a horizontal legend, a keyword of legend such as "topright" for a legend inside the plot, or "none".

cex.main, cex.lab, cex.axis, cex.legend

Sizes of the title, of the axis titles, of the axis and bar labels, and of the legend (and notes), relative to the default size.

...

Not used.

digits

Number of significant digits of the scores.

Value

print() returns x invisibly. plot() returns invisibly the matrix of plotted values, with one row per component and a last row BR, and one column per cohort.

See also

BenefitRisk

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(group = rep(c("Cohort1", "Cohort2"), each = 40),
                pfs_tte = rexp(80, log(2) / rep(c(8, 6), each = 40)),
                pfs_event = 1,
                response = rbinom(80, 1, rep(c(0.45, 0.30), each = 40)),
                ae = rbinom(80, 1, rep(c(0.35, 0.20), each = 40)))
eps <- list(Endpoint("PFS", "tte", time = "pfs_tte", event = "pfs_event"),
            Endpoint("ORR", "binary", var = "response"),
            Endpoint("AE", "binary", var = "ae", higher.better = FALSE))
crit <- data.frame(endpoint = c("ORR", "PFS", "AE"), target = c(0.3, 0.5, 0.3),
                   time = c(NA, 6, NA), cutoff = c(NA, NA, 0.5))
br <- BenefitRisk(d, eps, crit)
br
#> Posterior benefit-risk scores against target values
#> 
#>  component definition     weight cutoff
#>  ORR       P(rate >= 0.3) 0.333        
#>  PFS_S6    P(S(6) >= 0.5) 0.333        
#>  AE        P(rate <= 0.3) 0.333  0.5   
#> 
#>    group   ORR PFS_S6    AE admissible    BR selected
#>  Cohort1 0.996  0.955 0.627       TRUE 0.842     TRUE
#>  Cohort2 0.509  0.869 0.995       TRUE 0.761    FALSE
#> 
#> Selected: Cohort1
plot(br)

plot(br, col = c("grey80", "grey60", "grey40", "black"), legend.position = "top",
     cex.axis = 1.2)
